author: AIncient Labs
tooling: Hand-written; read by the weekly dependency scan (grype --vex) and published with each Atelier CMS appliance version. Products are package URLs, the form grype matches when it scans an SBOM; the scope is the appliance (ghcr.io/aincient-labs/atelier-cms and the images its compose.yaml runs).

statements.impact_statement: Fixed in ImageMagick 6.9.0 (2014). The appliance compiles ImageMagick 7.1.2 from source; the match comes from a CPE without a version range.
